products.limit_basis_notes: Unless stated otherwise, limits apply per adult and are not increased for accompanying children; Cancellation chosen limit and Rental vehicle insurance excess are per policy (shared across all insured persons). Travel delay payable up to $250 per 24 hours. Emergency luggage doubles if bags missing >72 hours.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Over 40 conditions automatically covered when criteria are met. Other existing medical conditions may be covered if declared, medically screened and approved with any advised additional premium/excess (Comprehensive and Annual Multi Trip only). If not automatically covered or approved, no cover for claims arising from that condition.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Pregnancy-related illness/events covered up to end of 26th week if event is covered by the policy and pregnancy-related illness first developed unexpectedly after purchase. Pregnancy itself is not an existing medical condition; existing pregnancy-related conditions require screening/approval where available. No cover for birth/newborn care.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cancellation/Additional expenses cover may apply for death, sudden serious illness or serious injury of a close relative or business partner resident in Australia or New Zealand (hospitalisation or need for your care required). Existing medical conditions of non-travellers are generally excluded unless automatically covered or specified for you.
products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers rental vehicle insurance excess or repair cost (whichever is lower) when renting from a registered company, vehicle has comprehensive insurance, and you are a nominated driver. No cover for liability from use of vehicle, administration or loss-of-use fees, or events not covered by the rental's comprehensive insurance.
products.luggage_conditions: Unattended property exclusions apply; valuables (PCs, smartphones, cameras, jewellery, electronic equipment, watches) not covered if left in any motor vehicle/motorhome/caravan; items must be with you unless stored securely with proof of forced entry; no cover for items in a tent; checked-in valuables excluded; depreciation applies per schedule; proof of ownership/value required; report theft/misdelivery promptly.
products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for travel to/remaining in regions with Australian Government 'Do not travel' advice; sanctions restrictions apply; certain government intervention/prohibition risks excluded; insolvency of providers excluded; pandemic exclusion applies except to specified medical sections and Coronavirus travel costs per policy wording.
products.claims_process_summary: Prevent further loss; notify authorities (police/carrier/hotel) as soon as possible; contact nib International Assistance in emergencies; submit claim as soon as you can with required documents (medical certificates, receipts, reports). Claims paid in AUD; decision target within 10 working days of complete claim.
products.emergency_assistance_details: nib International Assistance 24/7: +61 3 8523 2800 or 1300 555 019 (within Australia); travelassist@nib.com.au
products.premium_factors: Trip length; time between purchase and departure; destination/region; plan selected; traveller age; chosen cancellation limit; snow sports option; rental vehicle excess increase; specified items; variable excess; specified medical conditions.
